_comment: #475. No family issue (#470-#474) authored a Marina preset, so this template borrows, and the
borrowing is bounded by design #452 section 3, which names the pieces that must stay exclusive
to one neighborhood so districts read as themselves: the slanted bay and bracketed cornice
(Noe), the stucco arch garage, scalloped parapet and aluminium slider (Sunset), the steel sash,
loading dock and corbel cornice (SoMa), the tiled bulkhead (Mission), the squared bay (North
Beach). The flush garage and the panelled door are on nobody's exclusive list, and a 1920s
Marina flat is exactly a flush garage with a panelled entry beside it - so those two are
Marina therefore has no cornice, bay or storefront: every preset of those families is somebody
else's signature. Its own exclusives - tile eyebrow, stucco quatrefoil vent - have no generator
yet, so its identity still rests on window_marina_arched.
Slotting and gates are noe_valley_victorian's, same parts and same numbers (see the note
there): no garage below 5.26 m of frontage, never overlapping the door.
window minSpacingMeters 1.80 -> 2.40 = repeat.spacingMeters, the largest exclusion available
before PlaceProcedural's spacing = max(spacingMeters, minSpacingMeters) would thin the windows.
